441325: At the bottom of the sea, you can find an upside-down ship above a ravine. Swim inside the boat to find some cat paintings and 'MEOW!' scrawled into the ceiling.

441329: A boat carrying several cars has sunk to the bottom of the sea here. No loot in the area.
441330: A boat carrying several containers can be found on the sea floor here. Swim inside to find a lunch pail and some empty milk bottles.

Sticking out of a bottle at the edge of the rocky beach.

441396: A leaning lighthouse can be found here. Inside, you can find mirelurk eggs, ammo, junk, an explosives box, a mattress, a 10mm pistol and a safe with an expert-difficulty lock.

441406:

441418:

441419: A plane can be found here, with a few military grade circuit boards (and radscorpions) around it.
441420: A bus can be found here, surrounded by a Glowing One and several ghouls. Loot in and around the bus includes a few suitcases, a duffle bag, and a steamer trunk.
441421: Can usually be found soaking up rads outside one of the shacks near the [Crater of Atom](#loc=72001).
441422:
Found on six Enclave Soldiers wearing the X-02 power armor at the [Atlantic Offices](#loc=71850), during the 2024 New-Gen Update creation club quest [Echoes of the Past](#loc=441417).

After the lockdown is lifted, a Vertibird appears with another soldier wearing X-02 power armor, and two Enclave Hellfire troopers appear outside the offices wearing Hellfire power armor. 

Pickpocketing the fusion cores from any of these power armors allows the player to steal the frames, but this is extremely difficult under the circumstances. It is more practical to simply loot the armor pieces from them after they are killed.
441423:
Worn by the Enclave Colonel on the lowest level of the [Atlantic Offices](#loc=71850)' basement. Added to the game with the 2024 Next-Gen Content Update.

441424:

- [Southern Enclave Encampment](#loc=401453)
- [Eastern Enclave Encampment](#loc=401454)
- [Western Enclave Encampment](#loc=401455)
441425:

441427: Complete the radiant quest given by one of the settlers here to claim a workbench found next to the house.
441428: An unmarked cabin and public restroom can be found here. Stingwings can be found guarding the trunk and miscellaneous junk.
441429: Kill Phyllis Daily or speak to her and pass a speech check to claim this workbench, found behind a counter in the building.
441496:

441499:

441505: On a shelf inside the [Lexington Pharmacy](#loc=116470).

441510: After getting up onto the elevated freeway via the [Wrecked Bus](#loc=441509), you can follow a series of Railroad murals to find a truck at the eastern edge. 441513: A truck and trailer can be found by the side of the road here. Pick through the advanced-difficulty lock on the trailer door to find an ammo box, mattress, gwinnett brew, and some junk.

441516: An unmarked location entered through a blue door on the concrete bridge. Inside you'll find several junk items, a wooden crate with a novice-difficulty lock, and a hatch behind a blue barrel in the corner that takes you down to [Reactor Level.](#loc=441517)
441517:

441518:

441521: An unmarked interior entered through a trapdoor in the tower near the train tracks. Inside, you'll find a metal box, machete, chem box, junk, blood pack, and a corpse.

441974:

441976: College Square Station Interior. Once inside the station, go down the stairs to your left. 441983: In the inventory of Ricca, a corpse found on the bar's roof.

606690:
A Mister Handy food and drink trader, Bean can be found in Slocum’s Joe at [General Atomics Galleria](#loc=71817). Bean and the other Galleria merchants open for business after completing the miscellaneous quest [Galleria](#loc=401376). 

**Do not order coffee from Bean** before the Galleria is opened, since the room can ignite and Bean will turn hostile. After the grand reopening, Bean refuses to serve coffee due to safety concerns.
606691:
A food trader, Waitron can be found in Handy Eats Diner at [General Atomics Galleria](#loc=71817). Waitron and the other Galleria merchants open for business after completing the miscellaneous quest [Galleria](#loc=401376). 

**Save before interacting with Waitron** before the Galleria is opened. He will direct you to a booth and offer four options: mashed, diced, charbroiled, or a Charisma check to say you are not hungry. Choosing one of the first three options, failing the Charisma check, or leaving the booth too early will turn Waitron hostile and lock you out of his services as a trader.
606692:

**Save before interacting with Sprocket** while working to open the Galleria. During his demonstration, he activates a Mister Gutsy prototype that attacks, and Sprocket can also possibly become hostile during the fight.
606693:
